about.label: About Us
about.heading: A Leading Legal Practice in Cairo Since 2004
about.body: Founded by Ahmed Ibrahim El-Badry, Aktay Law Firm has established itself as a premier provider of legal services in Cairo, Egypt. We combine decades of courtroom experience with modern legal strategies to deliver exceptional outcomes.
about.mission: Our mission is to deliver high-quality legal services while upholding the highest ethical standards — providing personalized attention to every client.

services.label: Our Services
services.heading: Comprehensive Legal Services
services.sub: We provide tailored legal strategies across a full spectrum of practice areas.
services.s1d: Business formation, governance, M&A, and commercial contracts.
services.s2d: Civil litigation, ADR, mediation, arbitration, and appeals.
services.s3d: Transactions, title issues, land use, and zoning guidance.
services.s4d: Divorce, custody, child support, and adoption proceedings.
services.s5d: Employment contracts, workplace disputes, and compliance.
services.s6d: Trademark registration, copyright, patents, and licensing.
services.s7d: Defense representation and appeals for criminal charges.
services.s8d: Wills, trusts, probate administration, and power of attorney.
services.s9d: Fraud, deceptive practices, debt relief, and consumer rights.
